---
title: "Hazelnut crop and frost"
description: "Does a bigger hazelnut crop mean a lower price, and how much does a count of spring frost days say about the crop?"
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.site import charts
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
data_dir = SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(data_dir / "manifest.json")
stamp = ph.as_of_stamp(manifest) if manifest is not None else None

SOURCE = crop.exchanges[0]  # whose crop estimate is plotted (the Giresun exchange's)
CROP_COL = "giresun_estimate_t"  # the crop size plotted: Giresun exchange's estimate
FROST_YEARS = (2004, 2014)       # the two frost years that carry the crop/price link
FROST_LAST_MONTH = 4             # frost days are counted over March and April

prices = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "prices_monthly.csv", required=("month", "season"))
crop_by_year = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "crop_by_year.csv",
                                   required=("year", "season", CROP_COL, "season_avg_usd"))
frost = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "frost_by_year.csv", required=("year", "frost_days"))

without = None
if crop_by_year is not None:
    crop_df, crop_sub, crop_note = ph.crop_panel(crop_by_year, CROP_COL, prices)
    # The season still in progress is left out of every correlation on this page.
    partial = ph.partial_season(crop_by_year, CROP_COL, prices)
    without = ph.correlation_without_note(crop_by_year, CROP_COL, FROST_YEARS, partial)

built_at = manifest.get("built_at") if manifest is not None else None
frost_crop, frost_note = None, None
if frost is not None and crop_by_year is not None:
    latest_frost = int(frost["year"].max())
    frost_note = ph.partial_year_note(latest_frost, built_at, FROST_LAST_MONTH)
    frost_crop = frost.merge(crop_by_year[["year", CROP_COL]], on="year").dropna()
    if frost_note:  # a frost window still open: leave that year out
        frost_crop = frost_crop[frost_crop["year"] != latest_frost]
    if frost_crop.empty:
        frost_crop = None
```

```{python}
def lower_first(text):
    return text[0].lower() + text[1:]

parts = []
if crop_by_year is not None:
    parts.append(crop_sub)
    if without:
        parts.append(f"Two frost years carry much of that: {lower_first(without)}")
if frost_crop is not None:
    parts.append("A plain count of spring frost days says less: "
                 + lower_first(ph.frost_crop_subtitle(frost_crop, "frost_days", CROP_COL, SOURCE)))
found = " ".join(parts) or "Crop size against price, and spring frost against crop size."
ph.raw_html(ph.analysis_head_html(crop.name, "Crop and frost",
                                  "Bigger crop, lower price? And what frost does", found, stamp))
```

::: {.dash}

::: {#panel-crop-price .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = "Crop size against the season's price"
if crop_by_year is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Crop estimate against the season's average price."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, crop_sub))
    charts.show(charts.crop_vs_price(crop_df, CROP_COL))
    notes = ["Giresun exchange crop estimate against the season's average USD price."]
    if without:
        notes.append(f"The {FROST_YEARS[0]} and {FROST_YEARS[1]} frost years carry much of "
                     f"this link: {lower_first(without)}")
    if crop_note:
        notes.append(crop_note)
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(" ".join(notes))}</p>')
```
:::

::: {#panel-frost-crop .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = "Spring frost days against the crop"
if frost_crop is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "March-April frost days against the crop estimate."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.frost_crop_subtitle(frost_crop, "frost_days", CROP_COL, SOURCE)))
    smallest = frost_crop.nsmallest(2, CROP_COL)["year"].tolist()
    charts.show(charts.labeled_scatter(frost_crop, "frost_days", CROP_COL, "year",
                                       highlight=smallest, x_title="Frost days",
                                       y_title=f"{SOURCE} crop estimate", y_suffix=" t"))
    notes = ["The crop figures are the Giresun exchange's estimates.",
             ph.smallest_crops_note(frost_crop, "frost_days", CROP_COL),
             "A count of cold days does not say how hard or when the frost hit; one bad "
             "night at flowering can do the damage.",
             "Frost days: March-April days below 0 °C, averaged over the growing-area weather "
             "points (Open-Meteo)."]
    if frost_note:
        notes.append(frost_note + " It is left out here.")
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(" ".join(notes))}</p>')
```
